title: Lemon Rice
description: Cooked rice tossed with a tangy mustard-and-peanut tempering and fresh lemon juice — a bright, quick lunchbox favourite.
steps: Cook the rice with water until just done, with grains staying separate rather than mushy. Spread it out on a plate to cool and stop it clumping.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the chana dal, urad dal and peanuts, frying until golden.
Add the dried red chillies, green chillies and curry leaves, and let them sizzle for 30 seconds.
Stir in the turmeric powder, then add the cooled rice and salt, tossing gently to combine without breaking the grains.
Turn off the heat and stir in the lemon juice — adding it off the heat keeps the tang from turning bitter.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve at room temperature.
